title: 第5章 吃鱼2第6章 在邹家村出名
content_zh:
“梦儿，母亲的嘱咐你忘记啦！
不是让你别去代芳河那里玩吗！
怎么还抓了这么大条鱼回来。”
刚到家门口，母亲柳淼花唠叨道。
“母亲，孩儿知道错了，下次一定听你的嘱咐，不去河边玩了。”
追梦连忙认错道。
追梦一拍头，暗道：“太兴奋了，怎么把事忘记了。”
追梦接着骗道：“昨晚梦到一个老爷爷教我怎么做鱼吃，老爷爷说他的方法是仙厨传下来的，对食物除去异味很有用。”
“真的？”
养母疑问道。
“真的！
今天中午我来下厨，做出来的鱼肉包管好吃。”
追梦点头，并包下中午下厨的活。
见追梦要做鱼肉吃，说的煞有介事，柳淼花也就不阻拦。
追梦扛着黄金大鲤鱼走到厨房，拿刀切开鱼肚，闻了闻，确实有很大的腥臭味，比21世纪臭水沟里的鱼还要腥臭。
“是吧！
很腥臭吧！”
养母柳淼花在追梦身后说道。
“这个不是问题，看孩儿的。”
追梦想到了方法。

从记忆中，追梦得知，邹家村村民在食物上都没什么讲究，一般都是原汁原味，很少用香料。
大的方面讲，起源大陆尚武，对食物的需求偏向功效和能量补充。
鱼肉大多数没有什么功效，只能起到一些补充能量的作用，这样开发吃鱼肉的人自然就少了，长时间下来，就没人去开发吃鱼了。
目前，追梦想到的物资里面最容易搞到的就是鱼肉。
而且没有竞争对象，追梦决定在这个世上开发出独属于自己的鱼肉吃法，或者说把21世纪鱼肉的吃法带到起源大陆来，从而间接的为邹家村增加经济来源。
追梦开始操作。
第一步，追梦把鱼肚里的黑膜认真的去除干净，然后把鱼肉切成一片一片，再清洗几遍鱼血。
追梦正准备操作第二步时，邹麻子带着邹狗蛋过来了，同行的还有邹狗蛋的妹妹邹小花。
“来了”
追梦一声招呼，示意邹麻子三人等待。
追梦继续操作。
追梦准备用姜片、葱段、料酒腌制鱼肉。
这一步，出了问题。
content_en:
"Meng'er, you forgot mother's instructions!
Didn’t I tell you not to go to Dai Fanghe’s place to play?
Why did you catch such a big fish? "
As soon as I arrived at the door of my house, my mother, Liu Miaohua, was nagging.
"Mom, I know I was wrong. I will definitely listen to your instructions next time and not go to the river to play."
Zhui Meng quickly admitted his mistake.
Zhui Meng patted his head and said to himself: "I'm so excited, why did I forget about it?"
Zhui Meng then lied: "Last night I dreamed that an old man taught me how to cook fish. The old man said that his method was passed down from the immortal chef and was very useful in removing odors from food."
"Really?"
The adoptive mother asked.
"Really!
I will cook at noon today, and the fish will be delicious. "
Zhui Meng nodded and agreed to cook at noon.
Seeing Zhui Meng want to eat fish and meat, she said it seriously, so Liu Miaohua didn't stop her.
Zhui Meng carried the big golden carp to the kitchen, cut open the belly of the fish with a knife, and smelled it. There was indeed a strong stench, worse than the fish in the stinking ditch in the 21st century.
"Right!
It smells very fishy! "
Adoptive mother Liu Miaohua said behind Zhui Meng.
"That's not a problem, babysitting."
There is a way to chase your dreams.
From memory, Zhui Meng learned that the villagers in Zoujia Village were not very particular about their food. They usually had the original flavor and rarely used spices.
Broadly speaking, the origin of the mainland is martial arts, and the demand for food tends to be functional and energy supplement.
Most fish meat has no effect and can only play a role in replenishing energy. In this way, naturally fewer people will develop and eat fish. In the long run, no one will develop and eat fish.
Currently, among the supplies that can be obtained in pursuit of dreams, fish and meat are the easiest to obtain.
And since there was no competition, Zhui Meng decided to develop his own way of eating fish in this world, or bring the 21st century way of eating fish to the continent of origin, thereby indirectly increasing economic resources for Zoujiacun.
Chasing Dreams begins operation.
The first step is to carefully remove the black film from the fish belly, then cut the fish into pieces, and wash the fish blood several times.
When Chai Meng was about to take the second step, Zou Mazi came over with Zou Goudan, accompanied by Zou Goudan’s sister Zou Xiaohua.
"Coming"
Zhui Meng said hello and signaled Zou Mazi and the others to wait.
Chasing Dreams continues.
Zhui Meng is preparing to marinate the fish with sliced ​​ginger, green onions and cooking wine.
At this step, something went wrong.
